identity.name: RegimeAdaptiveMomentumAgent
identity.description: Long-only spot momentum allocator: reads CMC (price, Fear&Greed) to score market regime, scales deployment into the top BSC momentum tokens, and signs + executes spot swaps via TWAK (native gas); mints + heartbeats its ERC-8004 identity gaslessly via MegaFuel. Risk-first, DQ-safe. Trades from wallet 0xE8A30d24BbA030D3e8a844bD1c4F6e1374EA6215 (TWAK-signed).

strategy.name: mean_reversion
strategy.summary: Mean-reversion: buy 8-token names trading >1.0σ below their 20-bar mean, inverse-vol, regime-capped. Forward-gated capability arm with an adverse prior (reversal flips to momentum on majors) — promote with extra skepticism.

items.name: BNB_STRATEGY_01
items.summary: BNB_STRATEGY_01 (alias of momentum_adaptive) — Regime-adaptive momentum: hold top-2 of 8 by 120-bar return, inverse-vol; deployment scales with a live risk-on score (breadth + trend + vol + Fear&Greed).

items.name: BNB_STRATEGY_02
items.summary: BNB_STRATEGY_02 (alias of momentum_voltarget) — Regime-adaptive momentum: hold top-2 of 8 by 120-bar return, inverse-vol; deployment scales with a live risk-on score (breadth + trend + vol + Fear&Greed). | overlay: vol-target 1.2%/bar (de-risk only)

items.name: BNB_STRATEGY_03
items.summary: BNB_STRATEGY_03 (alias of dual_momentum) — Dual momentum: hold top-2 of 8 by 120-bar return with a positive-momentum cash filter; rotate FULLY to USDT when the basket itself is down over 120 bars. Long-only risk-off.

items.name: BNB_STRATEGY_04
items.summary: BNB_STRATEGY_04 (alias of rotation) — Relative-strength rotation: hold top-3 of 8 by a blended 120+60-bar momentum z-score, inverse-vol, regime-capped (no cash filter).

items.name: BNB_STRATEGY_05
items.summary: BNB_STRATEGY_05 (alias of breakout) — Volatility breakout: hold the 8-token names that break their 20-bar high (exit on the 5-bar low), inverse-vol, regime-capped. Asymmetric exit channel replaces the AMM stop.

items.name: BNB_STRATEGY_06
items.summary: BNB_STRATEGY_06 (alias of momentum_fast) — Short-horizon momentum: hold top-2 of 8 by 60-bar (~10d) return, rebalanced every 3 bars (12h); regime-adaptive deployment. Faster/reactive variant.
